hack.root_cause: Voting power privilege escalation via MakerDAO fork governance bug → mass CGT token minting
hack.description: Curio lost $16M when an attacker acquired a handful of CGT governance tokens and exploited a voting power flaw in its MakerDAO fork to gain full governance control, mint unlimited tokens, and drain the protocol.
